title: Sharp Ill-Posedness of the Euler Equations in Lorentz Spaces
summary: We study vortex stretching for the three-dimensional axisymmetric Euler equations without swirl in vorticity formulation. Danchin (2007) established global existence and uniqueness for bounded vorticity $ω_0$ provided $ω_0/r$ lies in the endpoint Lorentz space $L^{3,1}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ (together with a decay assumption on $ω_0$).
